description: Baseline + full GIP-0088 contract deployment (REO + IssuanceAllocator + RecurringAgreementManager on the audit-fix-3 ABI) via a post-audit contract image (gip-0088.env swaps CONTRACTS_VERSION and sets GIP0088_ENABLED=1). No indexing-payments services. Mock REO wired by default for tests; REO-A still deployed and available. Profile set: block-oracle + explorer + rewards-eligibility.
